level.description: The node's level after this finding. Equal to the floor when nothing changes.

evidence.description: What the code does, with names and lines. No hedging words, no advice.

evidence_kind.description: Required to set a level below the floor. The event is rejected without it. No evidence lowers a node that is high for missing proof.

critical.description: Needs a fix, not only a look: definite break, irreversible effect, or an unobserved behaviour change on a sensitive path. Only valid with level high.

rule.description: Stable slug for the class of problem. Same slug twice across reviews is a candidate for rule-promote.

questions.description: Aids for the reviewer, not decisions. A question never sets a level; `changes` says what an answer would change.
